info.title: Scrubkit.Tool — the scrubkit command-line tool
info.description: A dotnet tool that runs Scrubkit from any shell or CI: `scrubkit scan <folder>` walks a folder, extracts text + metadata from PDFs, Office/OpenDocument, email, EPUB, and text/images, optionally redacts PII and secrets, and writes a CSV / JSON / JSON Lines / Parquet table. Fully offline — no network calls.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: scrubkit 1.11.0+71cca2cea66b9fcac386ea76e23e789920c040cf — offline text + metadata extraction with PII/secret scrubbing

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format: csv, json, jsonl, parquet.
Default: inferred from --out's extension, else csv.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write to a file instead of stdout. Required for parquet.

options.name: --redact
options.description:
Redact PII + secrets. Level: standard (default) or aggressive.
Omit the flag to extract without redacting.

options.name: --rules
options.description:
JSON file of custom redaction rules + allow/deny/disable lists
(implies --redact). See the format in the Scrubkit.Tool README.

options.name: --no-recurse
options.description: Only the top folder (default: recurse all nested folders).

options.name: --hash
options.description: Compute a SHA-256 content hash per file.

options.name: --include
options.description: Comma-separated extension filter, e.g. --include .pdf,.docx

options.name: --since
options.description:
Incremental scan: only output files changed since <manifest>
(a missing file = first run). Skips unchanged files.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Write a manifest of this scan to <file> (for a later --since).

options.name: --max-files
options.description: Stop after n files (0 = no limit).

options.name: --max-bytes
options.description: Skip files larger than n bytes (0 = no limit).

options.name: --max-text
options.description: Clip extracted text to n characters (0 = no clip).

options.name: --local-time
options.description: Emit local-time timestamps (with offset) instead of UTC.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version.
